title: vtc: kicked users can rejoin immediately
description: Kick (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:935) sets leftAt, and rejoin is always allowed, so kicking has no lasting effect. Decide whether to define a re-entry restriction or leave it deployment policy.
close_reason: Kick blocks rejoin (SHOULD forbidden) until a moderator clears kickedBy. Known gap: an anonymous guest can rejoin as a new guest.
